content: भङ्गुर {%a.%} [भञ्ज्-घुरच्] .²1 Apt to break, fragile, brittle. .²2 Frail, transitory, transient, perishable; आमरणान्ताः प्रणयाः कोपास्तत्क्षणभङ्गुराः; सर्वमुत्पादि भङ्गुरम् <ls>H. 1. 181</ls>; <ls>Śi. 16. 72</ls>. .²3 Changeful, variable. .²4 Crooked, bent. .²5 Curved, curled; शशिमुखि तव भाति भङ्गुरभ्रूः <ls>Gīt. 10</ls>. .²6 Fraudulent, dishonest, crafty. .{@-रः@} The bend of a river.
